items.title: Spider-Man
items.line: Sam Raimi's film opened in the US on 3 May 2002 and took $114.8 million that weekend, the biggest opening in history at the time. Tobey Maguire wore the suit.

items.title: The Queen's Golden Jubilee
items.line: The jubilee weekend ran 1 to 4 June 2002. At the Party at the Palace, Brian May opened by playing "God Save the Queen" from the palace roof, and Paul McCartney closed the night.

items.title: World Cup in Japan and Korea
items.line: The first World Cup held in Asia ran from 31 May to 30 June 2002. Brazil beat Germany 2-0 in Yokohama for a fifth title, and Ronaldo finished top scorer with 8 goals.

items.title: The Wire
items.line: HBO aired the first episode of The Wire on 2 June 2002. David Simon's Baltimore story ran five seasons and 60 episodes, and it was mostly watched later, on box sets.

items.title: The Two Towers
items.line: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers reached US cinemas on 18 December 2002. Andy Serkis's motion-capture Gollum was the talking point, and the film took about $942 million worldwide.
